title: Illuminated Ge'ez Vellum Manuscript of the Garima Gospels (6th Century CE)

paleographical_telemetry.material: Goatskin parchment (vellum) bound with original wooden boards covered in gilded silver
paleographical_telemetry.script: Unpointed classical Ge'ez calligraphy in soot-based carbon black and cinnabar red rubrication ink
paleographical_telemetry.global_significance: One of the oldest surviving illustrated Christian gospel books in world history
